people.imagined: Spring levy morning on the lake shore. He has just finished calling the file to halt, and the whole plain of farmers is standing still behind him. A wild goose flies low over the water and he follows it with his eyes only. He has the old banner on his shoulder because the head always carries it at the levy.
people.subject: The moment: at first light on the lake shore at the spring levy, he stands square to the viewer with the old long grey banner resting on his right shoulder, his eyes following a wild goose flying low over the water just past the viewer's left, the whole plain of farmers standing still behind him. Face: a broad square weathered face of forty-eight, the jaw a hard rectangle, brown windburnt skin with deep lines from nose to mouth corners, a short grey-flecked beard cut flat along the jaw, heavy straight brows, small dark eyes level and a little cold, a thick nose, a wide flat mouth that does not smile. Hair: iron-grey, drawn up under a tall silver goose crown, a single very long grey goose feather standing upright at the left, the biggest thing at the top of the picture. Body: broad, square-shouldered, planted and still. Clothing: as head of the gate he wears the sect's richest dress: a short-skirted robe of dark grey-brown brocade silk with a high standing collar and narrow sleeves, a dark grey gauze over-robe falling in long folds, geese flying in formation embroidered in silver across the chest and hem, a braided silk belt hung with a jade pendant; no armour. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up the banner pole, a long grey silk strip pieced from bands of many slightly different greys with one small goose stitched near the top, no writing; the left hangs open and flat at his side. Power: a heavy earth-yellow aura like settled dust-gold round his shoulders, with thin watery blue motes drifting low over the ground. Background: a pale misty lake and a long blurred line of standing figures in grey-brown silk on the far shore. Light: cool silver dawn light from the upper left, the feather edged with thin warm gold. Expression: a still, level look, the whole plain waiting on him.

people.imagined: Late afternoon on a levy day. He has been drumming and shouting since dawn and has stopped to drink from a cask with the drum resting against his hip. He is laughing at a farmer who dropped his shield. The wine is making him red.
people.subject: The moment: late afternoon on a levy day on the lake shore, head thrown back in a big laugh at a farmer who dropped his shield, a wine ladle halfway to his mouth after drumming since dawn. Face: a huge round red-brown face of fifty-eight, wide cheeks flushed with wine, a big broken-looking nose, thick black brows with grey in them, small bright eyes crinkled nearly shut, a wide open mouth showing square yellow teeth, short bristling grey stubble. Hair: thick grey hair cropped short, bare-headed, a few strands stuck to the sweating forehead. Body: enormous, deep-chested and thick-necked, filling the width of the frame. Clothing: as an elder he wears the sect's richer dress: a short-skirted robe of grey-brown silk with the collar open at the throat and the sleeves pushed to the elbow over thick hairy forearms, a dark grey gauze over-robe slung off one shoulder, silver geese in formation along the hem, a wide braided silk belt through which a long wooden drumstick is thrust beside a silver goose crown hooked there; a small grey goose feather pinned to the left shoulder strap. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts a long wooden ladle of dark wine; the left rests on the taut pale hide of a big drum with a dark elm frame filling the lower right corner. Power: a warm earth-yellow glow round him, flushed with laughter, and a faint watery blue in the shadows. Background: blurred lake shore, rows of spears planted upright in the mud, low orange sun behind, a soft haze. Light: warm low gold light from the upper left, flushing his cheeks, a spirit-bright rim along the drum. Expression: roaring laughter with something hard under it.

people.imagined: Night on a ruined watch platform. She is alone between drills, a short sword on her back, tying her braid again. She has just looked up because she heard someone step on the stair and is deciding whether to be caught.
people.subject: The moment: at night on a ruined stone watch platform, alone between drills, one hand pulling her braid over her shoulder, her face turned sharply toward a footstep on the stair, deciding whether to be caught. Face: a long face of twenty-four with a strong square jaw, her father's; tanned brown skin, a few freckles across the nose, straight dark brows drawn down, large dark eyes alert and bright, a firm mouth with the lower lip caught between her teeth, no scars. Hair: black, in one thick braid over the left shoulder, a large grey goose feather woven into it, clearly visible, a small silver ring at its end. Body: tall, rangy and long-necked, narrow-hipped, a fighter's straight back. Clothing: a short-skirted robe of grey-brown silk with a standing collar buttoned to the chin and narrow sleeves, a little short in the sleeve and clearly cut down from a larger one, a crossed inner collar of pale silk, silver geese in formation on the cuffs, a braided silk belt and a narrow silk sling across the chest; over her right shoulder rises the hilt of a short plain sword worn high on the back, with a bare wrapped grip. Hands and objects: the left hand holds the braid; the right is closed on the sling strap near her collarbone. Power: a faint aura of watery blue-green round her hair, a few earth-gold motes drifting off the sword hilt. Background: a dark crumbling parapet, a few stars, a thin line of low mist, two blurred figures standing in a straight line far behind her. Light: pale blue moonlight from the upper left, a small cold shine on the sword hilt. Expression: wary and daring, the half grin of someone breaking a rule.

people.imagined: Dusk in the burial rows. He is kneeling among the row markers with his writing board on his lap, pausing between two small marks. He has just wiped his fingers on his sleeve and looked at the dark under his nails, a habit.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk kneeling among rows of low stone markers in the burial rows, his writing board on his lap, he has stopped writing and is looking at his own fingertips, black under every nail. Face: a thin, plain, bony face of fifty-five, the kind no one remembers, sallow skin, completely bald with a smooth pale scalp, thin pale eyebrows almost absent, small pale-brown eyes held down on his hands, a long thin nose, a narrow lipless mouth with corners turned slightly down, a few deep vertical lines in the forehead. Hair: none; his head bare, no feather. Body: thin, stooped a little, narrow shoulders, long neck. Clothing: a plain but graceful long robe of grey-brown silk with a low crossed collar and long sleeves rolled once at the wrist, a faint silver trace of geese along the hem, a grey braided silk belt; round his neck on a cord of undyed silk hangs flat against his chest a plain wooden board with a few blank paper sheets clipped to it, unmarked. Hands and objects: both hands raised before his chest, the fingers long and narrow, each of the ten nails rimmed black, drawn large and clear; a short stub of ink brush is held between two fingers of the right hand. Power: a faint cool blue-grey damp gathers round his shoulders, a few pale water-bright motes drifting low. Background: rows of small low grey stones in the grass fading into dusk, a dark gap between two of them, thin mist. Light: low dim blue dusk light from the upper left, a thin warm line along his bald head. Expression: quiet and careful, eyes held down on his hands, a man hiding something small and kind.

people.imagined: A break in the levy. She has let the drum fall silent to pour tea from a small kettle and is grinning across the mess line at a farmer who is still standing at attention because nobody told him to stop.
people.subject: The moment: a break in the levy, she has let the drum fall silent to pour tea from a small kettle, grinning wickedly across the mess line at a farmer who is still standing at attention because nobody told him to stop. Face: a round tanned cheerful face of thirty-two, wide cheekbones and a snub nose, a gap between her front teeth, thick short brows with one raised, bright dark eyes crinkled at the corners, a smear of drum-skin chalk on her chin, a dimple on the left cheek. Hair: coarse black hair in a high round knot on top of her head, a long wooden drumstick pushed through the knot like a pin, both ends sticking out, a silver goose-feather ornament tucked behind her ear. Body: sturdy, short and stocky with strong forearms, an easy slouch. Clothing: a short-skirted robe of grey-brown silk with two crossed collars, the collar loose and the left sleeve pushed up to the elbow, silver geese in formation on the borders, a narrow brown braided silk belt. Hands and objects: the right hand pours steaming tea from a small dented iron kettle into a clay bowl held in the left; her left wrist carries a wrapped band of red cord. Power: a faint earthy yellow-orange warmth about her, a few gold motes in the rising steam. Background: the edge of a big drum with pale hide, the lake shore, a row of distant stiff-standing farmers in the haze. Light: warm afternoon light from the upper left, steam glowing bright against the dark, a soft spirit-gold rim on her cheek. Expression: shameless amusement.

people.imagined: Rest day on the river bank at dusk. He stands in file posture even though he is alone, counting the dark ferries on the far side one at a time. His left leg is locked stiff. He has not blinked in a while.
people.subject: The moment: on a rest day at dusk on a river bank, alone but standing in file posture, counting the dark ferries on the far side one at a time, his left leg locked stiff. Face: a short broad face of sixty-two with a heavy square jaw, dark skin creased like old bark, heavy brows pulled together with a deep line between them, narrow dark eyes fixed and unblinking, a flat broad nose, a long tight mouth with a thin white scar at the left corner, a short grey-flecked beard. Hair: cropped grey hair, thin on top, a plain grey goose feather pinned flat against the side of his head. Body: short, heavy and thick-limbed, weight entirely on the right leg, the left held rigid and straight like a post, the knee never bending, chin level. Clothing: a short-skirted robe of fine heavy grey-brown silk with a high standing collar and a pale crossed inner collar, neatly hemmed with silver geese, a dark braided silk belt with a plain iron buckle; the left trouser leg wrapped from knee to ankle in tight bands of grey cloth. Hands and objects: both hands hang straight at his sides, thumbs along the seams, the right fist closed. Power: a heavy brown-yellow earth tone gathers round his feet and rises like slow dust-gold, thin and steady. Background: flat reed-green river water, a far shore with a row of tiny dark boat shapes drawn up on the mud, mist on the water, a bruised orange sky low. Light: weak orange sunset light from the upper left, a faint silver rim along the feather. Expression: stony, patient, a grief stored very deep.

people.imagined: The evening of the line test. He has stood from dawn to dusk and has just been told he passed. He has not yet understood he can move, and is still standing in exactly the same position with a blank face.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk after the line test, he has stood from dawn to dusk and been told he passed, and is still standing in exactly the same place, hands at his sides, not yet understanding he may move. Face: a young farm boy's round smooth face of twenty, wide-set eyes wide open and not blinking, gaze fixed straight ahead through the viewer, skin sunburnt red-brown across nose and cheeks, thick untidy brows, a slightly open mouth with the lower lip slack, a long straight nose, ears that stick out. Hair: thick dark hair cut by hand in a bowl shape with a cowlick at the crown; no feather yet, only a small bare spot on the hair-band where one would go. Body: tall and thin, a growing boy with big wrists, a rigid, perfectly straight back. Clothing: the sect's simplest graceful silk, a new short-skirted robe of grey-brown silk with a standing collar, slightly too big at the shoulders, the sleeves covering half the hands, a pale undyed cotton inner collar buttoned to the neck, faint silver geese on the border, a plain silk belt tidily knotted. Hands and objects: arms straight, fingers loosely curled, the knuckles chapped. Power: none beyond a faint pale green of young wood in the air about him. Background: a dusty empty field in blue dusk, a long line of footprints and a single dropped hat far behind, soft mist. Light: soft dusk light from the upper left, a warm orange rim on his cheek. Expression: blank, obedient, uncomprehending.

people.imagined: A river ford at morning after a swim she was told not to take. She stands knee-deep with her sleeves pushed up, her hair still wet, her fingers pruned. A teacher is somewhere behind her about to scold.
people.subject: The moment: at a river ford in the morning after a swim she was told not to take, standing knee-deep, holding her hands up and looking at her own fingertips, wrinkled and white from the water, a teacher somewhere behind her about to scold. Face: a narrow brown freckled face of sixteen, wet dark lashes, thin straight brows, big dark river-coloured eyes, shy but amused, a small rounded nose, a small closed mouth with a tiny smile held in, a drop of water running down the jaw. Hair: wet black hair in two plaits hanging heavily over the shoulders, a grey goose feather tied at the end of the left plait with a silver thread. Body: small, slight and wiry, narrow shoulders. Clothing: the sect's simplest graceful silk, a short grey-brown silk robe with a standing collar and a crossed inner collar wet at the neck, the skirt tied up out of the water in a knot at the hip, sleeves pushed above the elbows, faint silver geese on the cuffs, a plain braided cord belt; bare calves in the water. Hands and objects: both hands held up at chest height, palms toward her, the finger pads wrinkled deep as dried plums, drawn plainly. Power: a faint watery blue shimmer round her hands, a few water-bright motes lifting from the river. Background: soft green reed banks, a flat brown river with small ripples, a half-sunk flat ferry boat tied up, drifting mist. Light: clear cool morning light from the upper left, bright on the water behind, a pearly rim on her wet hair. Expression: guilty and delighted.

people.imagined: Night in the cooks' storeroom. He has crept in with a lamp covered by his hand and is bent over a sack of millet, head tilted as though listening to it. He has heard footsteps and has frozen, bent.
people.subject: The moment: at night in the cooks' storeroom, hunched over a sack of millet with one hand cupped round a small lamp, head tilted sharply as if listening to a well shaft, frozen because he heard footsteps. Face: a pinched narrow pale face of seventeen, the head tilted left, sunken cheeks, heavy-lidded eyes with dark rings, watchful and dull gold in the lamp, thin dark brows, a long thin nose, a mean small mouth with thin lips, a thin line of stubble on the upper lip. Hair: lank black hair to the ears, a grey feather stuck in it crooked. Body: thin and stooped, back rounded forward and the neck pushed out ahead of the shoulders; the stoop is the main thing. Clothing: the sect's simplest silk, a short-skirted robe of grey-brown silk with a standing collar, correct but worn badly, the collar rumpled, faint silver geese on the hem, a cloth belt with a small pouch that clinks. Hands and objects: the left hand shields a tiny clay oil lamp, lit through the fingers; the right grips the neck of a bulging cloth sack of millet, a few grains spilling. Power: none, only a dull yellow-grey pallor in the air about him. Background: dark sacks stacked to the ceiling, a hanging string of dried onions, deep shadow and a little drifting dust. Light: a small orange lamp glow from lower right lighting his chin and cheek only, a faint cold spirit-glint in one eye, everything else near black. Expression: furtive and counting.

people.imagined: Midnight on a watch post. She has been standing too long and has begun to bounce on her toes. She is retying her braid for the third time and looking down the dark line toward the point's post, wishing she were there.
people.subject: The moment: at midnight on a watch post, she has stood too long and begun to bounce on her toes, retying her braid for the third time and looking down the dark line toward the point's post, wishing she were there. Face: a freckled round face of twenty-two, slightly sunburnt, quick dark eyes flicking to the side, thin arched brows, a short upturned nose, a mouth that has begun a smile and stopped, a small chipped front tooth. Hair: long dark-brown hair in a loose braid, one thick lock escaping, tied at the end with a strip of green silk; a grey feather pinned over the left ear. Body: wiry, light on her feet, leaning forward, the left foot lifted. Clothing: a short-skirted robe of grey-brown silk with a standing collar and narrow sleeves, well fitted but creased from long standing, silver geese on the cuffs, silk wristbands, a braided cord belt with a small wooden whistle on it. Hands and objects: both hands behind her head holding the braid, elbows wide; a short spear leans against her shoulder, its shaft wrapped with reed strips. Power: a faint watery blue about her hands, a few cool motes. Background: a dark palisade, a dim lantern on a pole, a faint line of fog. Light: cold moonlight from the upper left and a pale lantern glow from the right, a soft silver rim on her hair. Expression: eager and restless, caught between duty and a hope.

people.imagined: Morning, in his grandfather's tent. He has just handed over the night's report and the old man has said something pleased. He smiles half a second late, as though he first checked what the smile should be.
people.subject: The moment: morning in his grandfather's tent, he has just handed over the night's report and the old man has said something pleased; he smiles half a second late, as though he first checked what the smile should be. Face: a pleasant, even, handsome face of twenty-four, a little too smooth, clean light-brown skin, neat straight brows, large dark eyes that sit slightly apart from the mouth, steady and watching, a straight nose, a mouth whose smile only reaches the lips, one side higher than the other, a tiny mole on the left jaw. Hair: neat black hair drawn into a tidy topknot with a silver and grey goose feather pin sitting exactly straight. Body: medium height, straight, well-groomed, the same broad build as his grandfather but narrower, shoulders held very even. Clothing: a short-skirted robe of the best grey-brown silk, perfectly pressed, a high standing collar over a clean crossed pale inner collar, silver geese in neat formation on the hem, a braided grey silk belt with a tidy knot, the cuffs exactly even. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a folded plain paper packet against his chest; the left is open, palm slightly up, a gesture of honesty. Power: a faint earth-brown tint round his shoulders, a few gold motes drifting. Background: a pale canvas tent wall with a hanging lantern, a half-drunk cup of tea on a stool, soft warm brown shadows, light mist. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left, an even glow with a soft spirit-gold rim. Expression: agreeable, practised, slightly too slow.

people.imagined: The last grey hour at Chiết Kích Nguyên, as a remembered portrait. He walks backwards at the end of the file with a wet cloth held at his mouth, eyes on the line he is leading out, the grey drifting round his shoulders.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder at forty-three, walking backwards out of a grey mist at the last hour at Chiết Kích Nguyên with a wet cloth raised to his mouth and nose, one arm stretched out sideways to hold back unseen people behind him. Face: a long hard stone-grey face, deep lines from nose to jaw; the cloth covers the mouth and lower face, leaving heavy straight brows and narrow dark-ringed eyes, set and stubborn, looking at the line ahead of him; a broad forehead, grey-flecked beard stubble above the cloth. Hair: close-cropped black hair with grey at the temples, a plain round silver cap with no feather yet. Body: broad, tall and strongly built, shoulders square. Clothing: the founder's robe, plain but fine: a short-skirted robe of brown-grey silk with a standing collar, silk straps crossing the chest, a pale inner collar, a plain belt, only a few silver geese just beginning on the hem. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a dripping wet cloth against his face; the left arm is stretched out sideways, palm flat, steadying someone beyond the frame. Power: a pale earth-yellow glow gathers faintly along his outstretched arm, wisps of grey mist curling round it. Background: thick grey fog, the dim shapes of a line of forty men with their hands on each other's shoulders fading away. Light: dim grey spirit-light from the upper left, everything desaturated. The whole picture faded and yellowed like old silk, edges darkened. Expression: grim and unmoved, a man who will not break.

people.imagined: A remembered portrait of the second head at the moment she signed the first levy contract with the cities: seated beside a new elm drum, calm, steady, her hand on the drum frame.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the second head as a woman of forty, seated at the lake shore in the quiet before the first levy under her contract with the cities, her palm laid flat on the frame of a new elm drum. Face: an even oval face with level features, smooth pale brown skin, straight evenly shaped dark brows exactly matched, steady dark eyes looking straight out, a straight nose, a firm small mouth with the faintest approving curve, a very faint line at each eye. Hair: black, smooth, parted in the middle and pinned into a low neat knot at the nape, one grey goose feather in it, perfectly vertical, held by a silver pin. Body: medium, straight, upright, shoulders level as a ruler. Clothing: as a head of the gate she wears the sect's richest dress: a short-skirted robe of fine grey-brown brocade silk with a crisp high collar over two crossed inner collars, narrow cuffs, a dark grey gauze over-robe, silver geese in formation across the shoulders, a braided grey silk belt with a jade pendant, a small dark elm leaf of jade pinned at the left collar. Hands and objects: her right palm lies flat on the dark curved frame of a big drum with a taut pale hide head; her left hand rests in her lap, fingers straight. Power: a soft earth-gold aura round her, steady and wide, thin blue mist lying at her feet. Background: the lake with a long line of farmers in grey-brown, small and evenly spaced, fading in mist. Light: soft spirit-light from the upper left. The whole picture faded and yellowed like old silk, edges darkened. Expression: composed, authoritative, quietly kind.

people.imagined: A remembered portrait of the file leader the morning he took ten men to hold the rope bridge, laughing with his men, banner in hand, not knowing.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a file leader of seventy-two, grinning broadly at the start of a march the morning he took ten men to hold the rope bridge, a short banner staff on his shoulder and one arm round a blurred younger man, not knowing. Face: a cheerful broad face with a thick neck, weathered tan skin crinkled by laughter, bushy white-flecked eyebrows, round bright brown eyes, a wide nose, a big gap-toothed grin, a thick grey moustache and short grey beard, a small old scar across the chin. Hair: thin grey hair tied back in a short tail, a grey feather stuck through the band at an angle. Body: stout, barrel-chested and thick-armed, a man at ease. Clothing: a sturdy short-skirted robe of grey-brown silk with a standing collar, silver geese in formation on the hem, a wide braided silk belt with a plain iron buckle, dark silk bracers on the forearms. Hands and objects: the right arm round the shoulder of a blurred younger man; the left hand hoists a short banner staff with a small grey silk pennant, unmarked. Power: a faint pale earth-gold glow round him, a few motes caught in the morning mist. Background: the two stout posts and slack ropes of a rope bridge in misty morning light behind him, nine blurred men in a file. Light: warm morning light from the upper left, a soft rim of spirit-gold. The whole picture faded and yellowed like old silk, edges darkened. Expression: a warm, joking, sure grin, a man who has crossed this bridge many times.

people.imagined: Noon drill on the lake shore. He has set his file facing the sun as always and he squints at it while giving the order, the sun full on his lined face, a hand shielding nothing.
people.subject: The moment: at noon drill on the lake shore, giving the order with his face straight into the bright sun, eyes squeezed nearly shut, his file set facing the sun as always. Face: a lean, hard, long face of fifty-two, burnt dark brown from decades of sun, a deep fan of white lines round each eye from squinting, heavy grey brows pulled together, a hooked nose, a wide stern mouth open on a barked word, a short grey-white beard cropped close. Hair: thin sun-whitened grey hair under a small round silver cap with one short feather. Body: lean, upright, straight-backed and narrow-hipped, the posture of a drill-master. Clothing: a short-skirted robe of fine grey-brown silk with a high standing collar and neat cuffs, a crossed pale inner collar, silver geese in formation on the hem, a black silk belt, and a square plate of polished bronze worn as a badge on the chest, sewn to the silk. Hands and objects: the right arm thrust out straight to point an order, the fingers together like a blade; in the left hand a short pale staff wrapped with cord. Power: a faint watery blue-green in the shadows, a few motes lifting off the shore. Background: a bright empty sky and the bleached shore, rows of small figures in grey-brown with raised spears, blurred, a shimmer of heat. Light: harsh high white-gold sun from the upper left, strong on his face and lines, a spirit-bright rim on the bronze plate. Expression: hard and stern, the jaw working, longing for a real war.

people.imagined: A caravan road at dawn, as she checks a line of escorts and weighs the picket lots in a cloth bag. She wears the thumb-guard because she never takes it off, and weighs the bag in her palm a moment longer than she needs.
people.subject: The moment: on a caravan road at dawn, weighing a small cloth bag of wooden lots in her palm a moment longer than she needs while her eyes check a line of escorts past the viewer. Face: a lean narrow face of thirty-eight with high cheekbones, light brown skin, level thin brows, sharp grey-brown eyes, assessing and cool, a long straight nose, a neat small mouth with no expression, a faint crease at one corner, a tiny pair of silver studs in her ears. Hair: black, pulled back hard into a low tight knot, a small grey silk band round it and a slim silver goose-feather pin. Body: slim, straight, upright and exact, narrow shoulders. Clothing: a close-fitted short-skirted robe of grey-brown silk with a stand collar and narrow sleeves, a crossed pale inner collar, silver geese in formation on the cuffs, a braided silk belt with brass studs; on the right thumb a thick archer's thumb-guard shaped like a half-cup in dark lacquered hide, the thing that stands out. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up a small drawstring bag of cloth, heavy at the bottom, from which a few smooth wooden lots show; the left holds a narrow strap of a long horn bow case across her chest. Power: a faint earth-brown glow along the bag, a few gold motes. Background: a dusty road, a line of laden carts with blurred escorts, a grey early sky, thin mist. Light: cool silver dawn light from the upper left, a soft rim on her cheekbone. Expression: neutral, calculating, hard to read.

people.imagined: In the mess hall, a first week at the gate. He is telling a bored table, again, whose elbow broke his nose, with his finger pointing at the bump itself.
people.subject: The moment: in the mess hall in his first week at the gate, pointing proudly at his own crooked nose while telling a bored table, again, whose elbow broke it. Face: a square youthful face of seventeen with a crooked nose, the bridge bent hard to the right and flattened, the most visible mark, drawn large, a fading yellowish bruise-shadow along the bridge, a wide eager mouth in a boastful half grin, one brow cocked high, bright brown eyes, a stubbled chin. Hair: short stiff brown hair standing up, a new grey feather stuck in at the front. Body: stocky and big-boned, shoulders already broad, leaning forward over the table with an elbow among the bowls. Clothing: the sect's simplest graceful silk, a new short-skirted robe of grey-brown silk a little stiff, the standing collar open over a pale inner collar, faint silver geese on the cuffs, a plain cloth belt. Hands and objects: the right forefinger points at the middle of his nose; the left holds a small wooden bowl of rice with a spoon standing in it; the knuckles are scabbed. Power: none, only a faint yellow earth warmth in the air. Background: a long wooden mess table crowded with bowls and chopsticks, a blurred row of other figures in grey-brown leaning in to listen, a rafter hung with dried gourds, smoky warm haze. Light: warm yellowish lamplight from the upper left, soft gold on his face. Expression: a cocky, loud, pleased-with-himself grin, one brow high, the bright eyes sweeping the table for an audience.

people.imagined: The night drill on the old tower. She holds the wet cloth to her face and breathes once. Then nothing, for far longer than anyone else can bear. The others have already counted twice.
people.subject: The moment: at the night drill on the old tower, pressing a damp cloth to her mouth and drawing one very slow, deep breath with her eyes closed, the others already counting twice. Face: an oval pale face of twenty, narrow and still, eyes closed with long dark lashes laid flat on the cheeks, smooth straight brows, a small straight nose, the mouth hidden behind the damp cloth, a faint blue tint of cold on the cheeks, a single bead of water on the temple. Hair: long black hair tied at the nape and falling down her back, a grey feather in the silk tie. Body: slender, quiet and straight-backed, shoulders relaxed and low, the chest rising in one long slow breath. Clothing: a tidy short-skirted robe of fine grey-brown silk with a high standing collar and a pale crossed inner collar, silver geese on the hem, a plain silk belt. Hands and objects: both hands lift a wet grey cloth folded into a square against her nose and mouth; a second figure's hand reaching to take the cloth appears blurred at the edge of the frame. Power: a cool watery blue haze gathers round her face and shoulders, tiny droplet-bright motes hanging unmoving. Background: dark old stone walls, a high cold window of stars, a line of blurred standing figures in grey-brown, a bucket of water on the flags at her feet. Light: faint cold blue moonlight from the upper left, catching the bead of water at her temple. Expression: a complete, patient stillness, the face given over entirely to the breath.

people.imagined: Night in the barracks. He sits on his bed holding the long drum case to his chest and glancing at the door. Something rolled inside the case rustles when he shifts. He has not let go of it all day.
people.subject: The moment: at night in the barracks, sitting up stiffly on a bed clutching a long drum case against his chest like a child, eyes flicking toward the door, something rolled inside the case rustling when he shifts. Face: a thin, nervous young face of twenty-one with a pointed chin, fair skin with the sheen of a fisher's boy, dark eyes wide and worried, the whites showing, thin straight brows raised and drawn in, a small tight mouth, a faint line of sweat on the upper lip, fine downy stubble. Hair: dark, short and tousled, a grey feather behind the ear. Body: thin, narrow-chested, hunched round the case, knees drawn up. Clothing: a short-skirted robe of fine grey-brown silk, buttoned crookedly one button off, a pale crossed inner collar, silver geese on the hem, a plain cloth belt; a cord with a small wooden float, a fisher's charm, round the neck. Hands and objects: both arms wrap round a long dark drum case of lacquered hide with brass studs, held against his chest, the top flap tied shut with a cord; the right hand grips the cord. Power: a faint watery green-blue about him, a few motes seeping from the case. Background: a bare bunk room, a straw mat, a lamp turned low, the door ajar and dark, a little mist at the sill. Light: dim lamp light from the upper left, the case highlighted, a cool moonlit rim on his hair. Expression: anxious, loyal, braced.

people.imagined: Weeding the burial rows at the end of a grey afternoon. She kneels between two markers humming, her hands deep in the soil and black under every nail. A few copper coins lie in her pocket and she has not thought about them.
people.subject: The moment: weeding the burial rows at the end of a grey afternoon, kneeling between two stone markers humming, both hands deep in the soil, a few copper coins in her pocket that she has not thought about. Face: a plain round brown face of nineteen smudged with soil on one cheek, soft brows, downcast dark eyes watching the ground, a short wide nose, a mouth shaped round the tune, relaxed, small dimples. Hair: thick black hair in a single short braid, a grey feather tucked behind it, a leaf stuck in. Body: sturdy and solid, kneeling with round shoulders bent forward, a basket of pulled weeds beside her. Clothing: the sect's simplest graceful silk, a short grey-brown silk robe with the sleeves rolled to the elbow and soil-stained cuffs but clean otherwise, faint silver geese on the hem, a pale inner collar, a plain cloth belt; a small purse at her side that bulges and clinks. Hands and objects: both hands pushed into the dark earth up to the wrist, gripping a pale root; every fingernail has a clear black crescent of dirt, drawn plainly. Power: a faint earth-brown and water-blue tint in the air, a few soft motes rising from the soil. Background: rows of low grey stones in thin grass, a gap in each row, a small bowl with a few copper coins at the nearest marker, a line of dusk-coloured hills, mist. Light: warm grey late-afternoon light from the upper left, soft on the back of her neck. Expression: absorbed and unaware, lips shaped round the tune, eyes on the soil.

people.imagined: She stands in file after a long day, weight on her right foot, the left foot light on the ground with a grey cloth bound round a small toe. She says nothing about it and nobody notices.
people.subject: The moment: standing in file at attention at evening after a long day, weight on her right foot, the left foot barely touching the ground with a grey cloth bound round a small toe; she says nothing about it. Face: a small hard brown face of sixteen, jaw set, level thick brows, steady dark eyes straight ahead with a hint of strain at the corners, a short nose, a mouth pressed into a line, a bead of sweat at the hairline. Hair: black, in a plain tight braid down her back, a grey feather in the band. Body: short, wiry and straight, shoulders back and chin level, weight on the right foot. Clothing: the sect's simplest graceful silk, a short-skirted robe of grey-brown silk buttoned high over a pale inner collar, faint silver geese on the cuffs, a plain belt; on the left foot a cloth sandal showing a little toe bound in a neat knot of grey cloth, the point of the picture, drawn clearly in the lower frame. Hands and objects: arms at her sides, fists closed. Power: a faint watery blue near the bound toe, a few motes. Background: a dusty parade ground at evening, a long line of other figures in grey-brown blurred, a lone goose in the sky, long shadows across the packed earth, light haze. Light: low orange evening light from the upper left on her cheek and shoulder, a spirit-pale rim on her braid. Expression: a silent endurance, eyes straight ahead, refusing to let a flinch show.
